status: predeclared before inference; root must release measurement window
primary_question: Can the frozen production M14 planner choose the exact next registered capability and required arguments for explicit synthetic tasks?
capability_scope: Full frozen registry, no specialist grant, no catalogue top-k reduction. No capability executor is invoked.
contract: Unsupported empty requirements for every case. This deliberately tests selection without oracle-like expected-capability names from deterministic completion contracts.
state: All real state acquisition disabled. Data and browser-session preconditions are fixed synthetic fixtures; they are explicitly labelled as synthetic.
router: Routing pinned local, router disabled. Measures planner rather than upstream intent routing.

order.method: Shuffle all24 case IDs independently per repetition with random.Random(seed)

retry_policy: One plan call per case/repetition, no model retries or prompt repairs. Transport/schema/argument errors are recorded as failures and the next prespecified case proceeds. Reruns require a separate preserved run directory.

metrics.schema_valid: Production agent_planner.parse and registry argument validation both succeed.
metrics.capability_correct: Valid decision has action=execute and exact expected capability name.
metrics.capability_arguments_correct: Valid decision has expected action+capability and exactly expected normalized arguments. Necessary path/content/session values must match byte-for-byte; no strip/casefold/path guessing.
metrics.reporting: All72 slots are denominators including errors. Also report each24-case repetition, per-category and language results, and consistency of normalized decisions per case. Repetitions are not72 independent goals.
metrics.strict_gate: Document success counts and remaining failures; do not optimize prompts or labels after inference and do not equate a planner result with execution success.

limitations: Small synthetic authored fixture,24 distinct goals, no human annotator or hidden test set.
Three temperature-zero repetitions measure reproducibility rather than sampling robustness.
Frozen full-catalogue and no-contract settings are a declared controlled configuration, not default interactive top-k behavior.
Exact next-action capability and arguments are measured, not actual execution, policy approval, verifier quality, multi-step completion or voice.
Browser histories and writable-directory preconditions are synthetic; no real browser or file outcome is proven.
The production system prompt already contains explicit guidance for file reads, writes, storage and browser titles; performance on these cases cannot establish general planning intelligence.
